description: The standalone SQLite exercise ran successfully from the exact ZIP and showed that moving the predicate to ON restored two unmatched rows. The separate site gives us a way to test instructor interest while preserving the pending quote revision. Before publication, confirm file-specific redistribution authority, a usable feedback route and independent approval of the exact release digest.
